signals_considered_detail:
`signals.py` ran on the committed panels: **41 groups at or above the thresholds** (strength >= 1.5 up or <= -2.0 down) of 53. Stamps: `spot_date` 2026-11-20 19:04 IST, `india_built` 2026-11-20 19:06 IST, `trade_month` **2026-09**, `wpi_month` **2026-04**.

**The ranking cannot be taken at face value today, and the reason is the stale WPI panel.** WPI is seven months old, and the top of the table is built on it. Crude oil ranks first at strength +10.70 on 'WPI Crude Petroleum 3m +85.6%' and 'WPI Petrol 1m +24.5%' - April figures - while the *fresh* evidence in the same group is Brent at US$91.58, **down 15.8% in a month**, and WTI down 16.0%. Silver ranks second at +10.16 on 'WPI Silver 12m +152.4%' while the global print is **-28.2% in a month**. The same applies to sulphuric acid (+6.97, 'WPI Sulphuric Acid 1m +20.9%' from April, against Shandong sulphur -10.7% and domestic sulphuric acid -7.7% over the last month) and alkyl benzene (+6.03 against Shandong benzene -27.1%). **A WPI-driven 1m or 3m line in today's signals.json describes April 2026.**

**What the fresh Indian prints actually say.** Sorted by the 1-month change computed from the dated history, every large mover with a reading since 10-Nov is either a Chinese domestic chemical quote (direction only, an aggregator) or falling. The exceptions, both worth stating:

1. **Domestic sugar is up while global sugar is down, and the group is labelled 'down' because of the global leg.** The sugar group carries strength **-1.73 down** entirely on 'Sugar (global) 1m -17.3%' and 'spot sugar 1m -15.0%'. The Chinimandi ex-mill prints for 20-Nov-2026, on a deep series (n ~1,002 readings since 2023-03-06, `stats.deep` true), go the other way: Kolkata M/30 Rs 6,006/qtl **+12.2% in a month, +37.5% in a year**; Delhi Rs 5,964 **+10.1% / +36.9%**; Muzaffarnagar Rs 5,932.5 **+9.9% / +39.9%**; Kanpur Rs 5,985 **+9.6% / +37.7%**; Kolhapur Rs 5,386.5 +4.7% / +35.7%. Three-month changes are NEGATIVE (-7% to -19%), so this is a rebound from an August fall, not a straight run, and `high_since` is 2026-11-19 for all of them - i.e. **yesterday**, so today's price is a shade below the recent peak and nowhere near the series high (Kolkata's is Rs 6,720, 10.6% above today). **No card published**: the group is below both publishing thresholds, Uttam Sugar Mills is already on the page from the price lane (2026-10-21), and the divergence needs the domestic-vs-global spread checked against a miller's own realisations before it is an idea. **Carried forward as a watch.**
2. **Steel's freshest Indian prints are a month to two months old.** Steel ranks +1.86 up. The Ministry of Steel series (**September 2026 report**, the latest available) has Mumbai TMT 10 mm at Rs 65,750/t **+15.5% on August and +21.0% in a year**, HR coil 2.50 mm at Rs 76,900/t **+10.8% / +29.2%**, CR coil 0.63 mm at Rs 89,670/t **+14.0% / +31.6%** - all `deep` true, 49-51 readings since 2021-11. The MetalBook city prints stop at **2026-11-02** (metalbook.com was blocked from the Actions runner too), so the Indian rupee evidence for steel is 18 days old at best and two months old at the official series. VRAJ, the only small cap in the steel group's benefit list, is already published (2026-10-13).
